title: NVlabs/ProtoMotions official implementation
summary: Official ProtoMotions 3 framework exposing explicit MDP component bindings, environment context views, multiple motion-learning agents, MaskedMimic sparse conditioning, experiment composition, ONNX tracker export, and standalone MuJoCo inference. Inspected only, not vendored.
license: Apache-2.0 with separate third-party software, model, dataset, and asset licenses

metadata.redistribution: No code, checkpoints, robot models, body models, motions, configurations, datasets, or assets are copied.
